name: Net
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: When taking the Attack action, replace one attack by throwing a Net at a visible creature within 15 feet. Dexterity save DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + PB or Restrained until escape; Huge or larger succeeds automatically. Target or another creature within 5 feet takes an action and DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to free it. Destroying Net also frees it: AC 10, HP 5, immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison and Psychic damage.

definition.name: Net
definition.description: {'type': 'entries', 'name': 'Special', 'entries': ['A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is restrained until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a 10 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.']}
